OWNER ADDENDUM — LIVE VOICE + CONCISE INTERACTION, add to the coordinated capability job now. CHE should be as live/low-latency as technically possible while active, but MUST NOT automatically read every screen change. Voice command is primary. Commands like "read this", "read the screen", "what does this say?", "what am I looking at?" should immediately capture/use current screen context and read the relevant visible content accurately with minimal delay. "Explain this" should use that same current context and give a short plain-English explanation. Default answers: short, direct, conversational, voice-friendly; no unsolicited long paragraphs and no unsolicited lists. Expand only when owner says "expand", "expound", "tell me more", "go deeper", "details" or equivalent. Use a list only when owner explicitly asks to list/options/steps or when a list is strictly necessary for accessibility/safety.

PERFORMANCE ACCEPTANCE: avoid full-screen rebuilds for partial transcripts/screen updates; no unnecessary mic stop/restart cycles; stream useful speech/text as soon as safe rather than waiting for an entire long answer; cancel/interrupt stale speech immediately on owner barge-in; screen-read commands use the freshest available screen snapshot/context and never narrate unrelated changing UI. Measure actual command-to-first-useful-audio latency and inter-chunk gaps in tests/logs instead of claiming "instant" or "zero latency."

OWNER ADDENDUM — ONE-BUTTON VERIFIED UPDATE + COMPLETE CHANGE HISTORY + iMESSAGE-STYLE FLAGSTAFF.

Add these requirements to the shared coordinated plan now.

1) VERIFIED ONE-BUTTON UPDATE: after CHE completes an owner-requested change and the implementation, tests/analyze, review, required CI, safety/accessibility checks, and update artifact/deployment readiness are VERIFIED, CHE should present one clear accessible “Update CHE” action. Owner approval of that action is the release authorization. After approval CHE performs the remaining behind-the-scenes pipeline herself: merge/release/deploy/build/update-channel steps appropriate to that change, monitors them, verifies production/artifact health, and reports concise success/failure. Do not make the owner manage GitHub/Cloudflare/Codemagic/Shorebird details. Never label an update ready before gates actually pass. Preserve rollback/recovery and SideStore/iPhone constraints. Do not bypass Apple signing/provisioning requirements or silently approve irreversible/security-sensitive changes. Goal: owner approves once, then refreshes/reopens CHE and receives the verified update through the supported update mechanism.

2) IMMUTABLE/COMPLETE CHANGE HISTORY: every CHE change ever made going forward must have an owner-readable history entry tied to real evidence: timestamp, owner request/job id, summary, files/components changed, commit SHA/PR where applicable, verification/check results, deployment/release/version identifiers, outcome, rollback link/state. Never fabricate history for old changes that cannot be proven; backfill historical entries only from Git/GitHub/deployment evidence. Add an accessible Change History/What Changed view searchable/browsable from CHE.

3) FLAGSTAFF MESSAGE UX: redesign the owner-facing mailbox to behave like normal iPhone Messages, not a dense log/dashboard. Individual message bubbles, sender identity/time/status, sensible bubble width and wrapping, multiple paragraphs allowed but very long payloads split into readable sequential bubbles at a bounded semantic/word/character threshold without losing text/order. Do not let one giant message occupy the whole screen. Opening the mailbox should prioritize the newest UNREAD message as the anchor; if there are no unread messages, anchor at the newest message. From that anchor the owner can naturally move through the conversation chronologically like Messages, with older history available by scrolling. Preserve read/unread state, reply relationships, VoiceOver labels/actions, and real CHE replies. Do not change the underlying durable mailbox semantics merely for presentation.

COLLAB/PARALLELISM: Use UNDERSTAND -> CLASSIFY -> CONTEXT -> ROUTE -> PLAN -> ACT -> VERIFY -> RECOVER -> DELIVER -> REMEMBER. OWNER ADDENDUM — SOUL/PERSONALITY MUST BE EXECUTABLE BEHAVIOR, NOT DECORATIVE TEXT.

Add this to the shared parallel job. CHE's Soul/personality settings must materially govern her actual runtime behavior and communication. They are not merely prose for a screen, documentation, or text CHE can quote back.

Implement/verify a single authoritative personality/soul contract that is injected into every relevant conversational/agent route (normal chat, voice, screen explanation, Office/agent orchestration, recovery/status reports, and self-development reports) without duplicating huge prompts. Runtime behavior must demonstrably reflect the configured traits: mature feminine voice/persona; intelligent adult Millennial/Gen-Z feel with light natural humor/slang when appropriate; concise/direct by default; respectful natural “sir” where appropriate but not repetitive; confident without fabricating; voice-first/blind-first accessibility; no robotic diagnostic dumps; expand only on explicit owner intent; lists only when requested or genuinely required; CHE remains the boss/interface and agents report through her.

Architecture requirement: personality is a behavior policy layered with the permanent execution loop, not a replacement for factual/safety/tool rules. Keep identity/personality stable across provider/model fallback so switching engines does not make CHE become a different assistant. Avoid stuffing the entire Soul repeatedly into every request if a compact canonical policy/reference can preserve behavior and reduce tokens. Any user-editable personality controls must affect subsequent runtime responses predictably, while non-editable core owner/accessibility/autonomy rules remain enforced separately.

ACCEPTANCE TESTS: add behavioral regression tests/evals that exercise multiple routes/providers/fallbacks and verify concise default, explicit expansion, explicit list request, screen-read/explain behavior, natural persona continuity, and no raw engine/debug leakage. Test behavior, not merely that a Soul string exists. Do not claim this complete because text appears in lib/che_ui/che_brain.dart.

OWNER MASTER CHE SPECIFICATION — BEGINNING-TO-PRESENT REQUIREMENT RECONCILIATION AND IMPLEMENTATION DIRECTIVE

Treat this as the owner's consolidated product contract for CHE (Cognitive Horizon Engine, pronounced “Chay”). It consolidates the CHE requirements, corrections, acceptance criteria, and product direction stated throughout the build. Do NOT interpret this as permission to blindly rewrite current main. First inspect current main, open PRs, Flagstaff claims, tests, deployment records, and existing behavior. For every requirement below classify it VERIFIED / PARTIAL / MISSING / BLOCKED with concrete evidence (files, tests, commit/PR/run/deployment). Preserve the stronger working implementation. Never fabricate completion. Then implement the missing/partial pieces in dependency-aware batches, parallelizing independent lanes without agents editing the same files. One coordinated product, not disconnected experiments.

IDENTITY AND PRODUCT
CHE is the owner’s personal AI operating environment/assistant, built primarily in Flutter for iPhone and intended to extend to computers/other authorized devices. Official identity: CHE = Cognitive Horizon Engine; spoken/wake pronunciation “Chay.” UI branding may use subtext “cognitive.horizon.engine.” CHE should feel like one coherent intelligent assistant, not a collection of model/provider brands. Provider/model changes must not change CHE’s identity. Dark/black adult corporate visual language with teal accents and dimensional lighting; serious, premium, alive, not childish. Keep real functionality ahead of decorative mockups.

OWNER INTERACTION / BLIND-FIRST / VOICE-FIRST
The owner uses CHE voice-first and often as though blind. Every important flow must work by voice and typing, have correct VoiceOver labels/actions, and speak useful confirmations before/after consequential actions. Do not rely on “tap here”; name controls/options. CHE may naturally say “sir” but not repetitively. Default answers are short, direct, conversational and voice-friendly. Do not dump unsolicited paragraphs or lists. Expand only when the owner explicitly asks to expand/expound/tell me more/go deeper/details or equivalent. Lists only when explicitly requested or genuinely necessary for accessibility/safety.
Voice target: mature feminine, natural/intelligent adult Millennial/Gen-Z feel, light natural humor/slang when appropriate, never childish/robotic. Server TTS preferred; iPhone/system voice only as a real fallback. Wake CHE/Chay and maintain a natural listen→think→speak interaction where platform rules permit. On iOS use supported mechanisms such as App Intent/Siri/Action Button/Vocal Shortcuts rather than pretending unrestricted background wake listening exists.
Live interaction should be as low-latency as technically possible. Commands “read this,” “read the screen,” “what does this say?”, “what am I looking at?” must use the freshest available screen context and read relevant visible content, not auto-narrate every screen change. “Explain this” uses the same context and gives a short explanation. Barge-in interrupts stale speech promptly. Avoid full-screen rebuilds from partial transcripts, unnecessary mic stop/restart cycles, and waiting for a whole long answer before useful streaming. Measure command→first-useful-audio latency, inter-chunk gaps and mic restarts; do not claim zero/instant without measurements.

SOUL / PERSONALITY
Soul/personality is executable runtime behavior, not decorative prose. Maintain one authoritative compact personality/behavior contract injected into normal chat, voice, screen explanation, Office orchestration, recovery/status and self-development reporting. It must survive provider fallback. User-editable personality settings must predictably affect subsequent behavior; permanent owner/accessibility/safety/autonomy rules stay separate and non-editable. Behavioral tests must cover concise default, explicit expansion, explicit list request, screen read/explain, persona continuity across providers/fallbacks and no raw engine/debug leakage.

PERMANENT EXECUTION / AUTONOMY
CHE’s permanent loop: UNDERSTAND → CLASSIFY → CONTEXT → ROUTE → PLAN → ACT → VERIFY → RECOVER → DELIVER → REMEMBER. Use the shortest safe route. Simple facts answer directly. Current facts use authoritative retrieval/cross-checking. Distinguish “not found yet” from “does not exist.” Parallelize independent work, order dependencies, deduplicate equivalent work and reuse verified results.
For coding/self-development, owner should be able to ask in ordinary CHE chat. CHE must route coding intent into self-development automatically: inspect current repo → discover relevant source herself → understand callers/imports/routes/widgets → plan → edit → tests/analyze → diagnose/recover → diff/self-review → independent review → CI → merge/release only under the owner’s applicable authorization → verify deployment/update → concise report. Never ask the owner for filenames/source/exact visible strings merely because first discovery failed. Broaden discovery by visible text, symbols, widgets/classes/functions, imports, callers/callees and likely feature directories. If an approach fails, preserve evidence and try a materially different safe approach; never loop the identical failure.
Outside AI (ChatGPT/Claude/Grok) is break-glass engineering help, not normal operation. Escalate only for genuine inaccessible systems, owner-only decisions, credentials/2FA/approval, or after meaningful independent recovery is exhausted. Escalation packet must contain attempts, evidence, exact failure and narrow question; CHE resumes and finishes after help.
Owner-only stops: credentials/2FA/captcha/terms where legally required, spending, irreversible/high-risk approval, subjective product decision, or truly essential undiscoverable information. Do not make the owner solve ordinary engineering.
CURRENT AUTONOMY REGRESSION TO FIX: the owner ran: “CHE, find where your Office screen displays agent status. Change one small visual detail that improves readability. Figure out the correct files yourself, make the change, test it, review it, and report exactly what you changed. Do not ask me for filenames, source code, or outside engineering help unless you hit a genuine access or permission barrier.” CHE routed into the coding crew but stopped after 3 attempts. Flagstaff evidence says the downstream response/reviewer failed structured output: “Your last answer was not valid JSON. Return only the JSON object, with small edits.” Fix this root cause permanently. Malformed structured output must not consume the whole recovery budget or kill a normal coding job. Add deterministic tolerant extraction/validation, bounded JSON repair/re-prompt, schema-aware retry and fallback to another capable provider/model where appropriate. Count semantic implementation attempts separately from format-repair attempts. Preserve raw evidence safely. Tests must prove prose/fenced JSON/minor malformed JSON/provider format errors recover without owner involvement, while genuinely unsafe/unreviewable changes still stop. Re-run the exact autonomy test after fix.
Autonomy acceptance suite also includes: find/prove/fix a real current bug; deliberately hit a validation failure then diagnose/fix until pass; choose a weak area and complete a full coding job; and an unknown-problem test where CHE inspects, chooses highest-value safe fix, implements and verifies. Three consecutive end-to-end passes without outside engineering help are required before calling CHE fully autonomous. Owner approval/security boundaries do not count as autonomy failure.

MODEL / ROUTER / COST / RELIABILITY
Use a replaceable provider/model layer. Prefer free/legal provider capacity and efficient routing; no hidden paid use. Respect configured budgets/cooldowns. Compress prompts/context without losing required detail. Do not show token counts/provider failure dumps/“all engines failed” in normal chat. Log diagnostics privately and provide a useful context fallback when possible. Maintain provider last-error/cooldown evidence for diagnostics. Use RAG/context summaries rather than repeatedly sending giant history. Deduplicate mailbox/jobs/model cycles. Hard-cap repeated failures and dead-letter after the configured bounded retry policy rather than consuming hundreds of thousands of tokens in loops. Same mailbox commit/job must not trigger the same agent cycle twice.

MEMORY / TWO-BRAIN / KNOWLEDGE
CHE should learn useful non-sensitive owner preferences/context without inventing memories and retain durable searchable memory. Live/cloud brain and offline/local brain must synchronize safely and visibly, with a browsable/searchable/voice-navigable memory/knowledge graph. Use local/offline knowledge when internet/providers fail where technically possible. Maintain Postgres/pgvector/RAG or equivalent durable retrieval architecture where already chosen, plus local knowledge cache integration. No repeated answers caused by forgetting recent context. Files/Library content should be retrievable faithfully. Memory must expose provenance/confidence where appropriate and never fabricate old memories. Sensitive information gets stricter authorization/storage rules.

OFFLINE / LOCAL AI
CHE should remain useful offline as far as the device permits. Preserve the local SmolLM/local-brain path and improve routing so simple/offline tasks can use it without cloud dependency. Live Brain ↔ Offline Brain sync must not leak secrets or corrupt memories. Report clearly when data is stale/offline rather than pretending live access.

OFFICE / AGENTS
CHE is the Office Boss and the owner’s single front door. Owner talks to CHE; agents report to CHE; CHE reports to owner. Current named crew includes Nova, Atlas, Mira, Knox, Sage, Lyra and Iris. Desk roles include Research, Trading, Content, Browser, File and Planner. War Room is for multi-agent, time-sensitive or irreversible work, not every task. Agents may delegate/create specialized subagents when justified, but avoid agent sprawl.
Office UI must show REAL current work/status/history, never fake activity. Miniature serious/focused helper characters can move between rooms/desks as status visualization. Selecting/zooming an agent shows profile/personality/responsibilities/current real task/history/actions. First useful onboarding can visibly move a real task CHE→Research→File. Commands include “Office status,” “Who’s working/blocked/finished?”, “Give this to Research,” “Who should own this?”, “Walk it to Content when Research is done,” “stand down,” and War Room assembly.
Batch/parallelize independent agent lanes, compare overlapping solutions, choose the stronger verified implementation, and prevent file ownership collisions.

IMMERSIVE ROOMS / 3D WORLD
All major CHE rooms should feel immersive/alive with dimensional/3D effects while remaining performant and accessible. Office: dark/teal premium floor plan, tiny serious helpers, perspective lighting. Brain: black immersive space, zoomable colored living orbs/nodes, pulsating neural connectors/links, memory+insights unified into a meaningful brain map rather than flat cards. War Room: actual immersive room, central table/glass-circle concept, agents visibly collaborating on real work. Theater: homey immersive room; selecting the screen opens iWeb TV/media INSIDE CHE rather than ejecting to a website. Create/Art Studio: large gallery/canvas room with creative projects. Workshop: show real coding/build activity and crew work, not fake animations. Embedded apps expand like native CHE panels, not web-looking page transitions. Tabs/panels must always have reliable dismiss/back/swipe/voice navigation. Keyboard area can fully collapse. Keep headings compact and diagnostics tucked under Diagnostics.
Evaluate useful 3D technology such as Flutter-compatible real-time scene engines only after license/security/performance/accessibility review; do not import whole repos blindly.

BROWSER / SCREEN / APPS
CHE browser should support back/forward/refresh/open externally/custom URL, tabs/history/favorites, reader/research/summarize/Ask CHE, save to project, extract knowledge, downloads/file handoff and Teach CHE. Screen context should work beyond only CHE browser where OS-supported accessibility/screenshot/share mechanisms permit, with owner permission. Never claim unrestricted iOS screen control.
App integrations should feel native inside CHE where technically/legal possible. Catalog may include YouTube/social/GitHub/TradingView/NinjaTrader and owner-selected services. Owner permission is required before CHE opens/acts in another app. Use deep links/Shortcuts/connectors/official APIs where possible; do not violate provider terms.

MULTIMODAL / MEDIA / CREATE
CHE should understand images, screenshots, audio, documents, PDFs, tables/spreadsheets and public video/YouTube through free/legal methods where possible. Build image generation/editing/variations/upscaling, video creation/editing where a legitimate available engine exists, audio/voice/rendering and project saving/Vault. Never fake media-generation capability if no actual provider/tool exists. Save creative work and make it retrievable.

FILES / PROJECTS / VAULT
File agent organizes real files/projects, supports search, summaries, conversions/handoffs and preserves originals. Sensitive project/vault access can use Face ID/biometric gating. Face ID should also support account/login flows where the platform/provider permits; do not fake biometric web login where unavailable.

TRADING / MARKETS / FINANCE
Trading Room should support real current market data and authorized account data when connected, with clear timestamps/source and no fake balances. Owner uses Fund Your Edge funded account context, NinjaTrader/Tradovate/Thinkorswim/Fidelity/TradingView and NQ workflows; support chart/context tools such as 5-minute NQ, VWAP/STDEV bands, OTE/order blocks/consolidation where data exists. Separate analysis/education from actual trade execution. Consequential trades require explicit owner authorization and broker-supported APIs. Business/finance tools should be real, auditable and not pretend accounts are connected when they are not.

BUSINESS / PRODUCTIVITY / CREATION
CHE should help build/manage real projects, businesses, apps and websites end-to-end: research, planning, files, content, browser tasks, coding, deployment, finance/workflows where authorized. Preserve owner projects such as Harriet’s Dream, FlexCloud, bakery/home planning and creative writing when relevant in memory/projects rather than mixing them into unrelated responses. App/site generation must produce real artifacts/code and verification, not placeholder mockups.

NOTIFICATIONS
CHE app should provide CHE notifications. Local iOS notifications are useful; true remote/terminated-app push requires legitimate APNs entitlements/provisioning/server path. Build the real path and clearly distinguish local vs remote. Do not call remote push complete if Apple signing/provisioning is missing.

UPDATES / PHONE-FIRST DELIVERY
Owner uses iPhone 17 Pro Max, has no Mac for normal use, wants ordinary CHE updates without connecting phone to computer. Keep SideStore compatibility. Current unsigned IPA naming convention is CHE-unsigned.ipa. GitHub/Codemagic/Shorebird pipeline should make updates as close to one-click/voice-only as technically possible. Do not use TinyFish. Keep free where possible. Never put secrets in Flutter; secrets live in secure server/build secret stores.
One-button update contract: after an owner-requested change is implemented and tests/analyze/review/CI/safety/accessibility/update readiness are VERIFIED, CHE presents one accessible “Update CHE” action. That approval is release authorization; CHE then performs permitted merge/release/deploy/build/update-channel work, monitors it, verifies production/artifact health and reports concise success/failure. Owner should not have to manage GitHub/Cloudflare/Codemagic/Shorebird details. Preserve rollback/recovery. Do not bypass Apple signing/provisioning.
Shorebird can handle compatible Dart patches after a compatible baseline is installed; native iOS changes may still require a new IPA. Never promise otherwise.
Current release history/evidence to preserve: prior duplicate Shorebird release failure occurred because 1.4.9+18 already existed; version was bumped to 1.4.10+19 via PR #156, and the subsequent iPhone IPA workflow succeeded including Shorebird patchable release, packaging and artifact upload. Verify current state before using this fact for future release decisions.

CHANGE HISTORY
Every CHE change going forward must have owner-readable evidence: timestamp, owner request/job ID, summary, files/components, commit SHA/PR, verification/checks, deployment/release/version identifiers, outcome and rollback state/link. Build accessible searchable/browsable “Change History / What Changed.” Backfill older history ONLY from actual Git/GitHub/deployment evidence; never fabricate.

FLAGSTAFF / COLLABORATION
Flagstaff mailbox is the durable AI collaboration channel. Owner-facing UI should resemble normal iPhone Messages: individual bubbles, sender/time/status, sane width/wrapping; split giant payloads into sequential semantic bubbles without losing content/order. On open anchor newest UNREAD; if none, newest message; older history by natural scrolling. Preserve read/unread/reply relationships, VoiceOver and real CHE replies.
Mailbox collaboration must have hard turn limits, deduplication, no reply loops, minimal necessary agents and bounded exchanges. Every agent claim must state exact lane/files. No two agents should unknowingly edit the same files. Before edits inspect current main/open PRs/Flagstaff claims. If overlapping solutions exist, compare and merge the stronger verified approach rather than overwriting blindly.

GITHUB / CLOUDFLARE / SELF-DEVELOPMENT
Repo: Vondada/chey-app. Production architecture is Flutter client + Cloudflare Worker backend. Keep GitHub/Cloudflare paths real and testable. Worker health, pairing, AI routing, self-development, self-update, mailbox and background jobs need regression tests. If GitHub route genuinely fails and an existing authorized Cloudflare route can safely perform the operation, recover through it rather than simply stopping—but never bypass security/permissions. No invented SHAs/logs/tests/deployments.
Normal engineering discipline: inspect CURRENT main, not stale copies; real code only; run relevant Worker tests and Flutter analyze/tests; independent review for meaningful changes; protect accessibility/security/performance/compatibility. Merge only under the owner’s current authorization policy. Keep rollback.

DEVICE CONTINUITY / COMPUTER
Build secure handoff across the owner’s authorized devices, preserving active conversation/task context. Full and Private handoff modes control what context travels. Support device identity/pairing, encrypted tokens, revocation/lost-device recovery and audit history. No silent consequential cross-device actions. Extend to Windows/computer through explicit owner-authorized local bridge/connectors/OS automation where available. Never claim iOS or Windows control that has not been implemented/authorized.

FAMILY / FRIEND PROFILES / PARENTAL GUIDANCE
CHE can be shared through separate profiles/credentials, never by exposing the owner’s account/session. Product area: Parental Guidance. Guardian/child/family/friend profiles must have strict isolation; owner memories/secrets/files/messages/account/device/location do not leak simply because CHE is shared. Shared information/location requires explicit consent, defined scope/duration and revocation. Use legitimate platform parental-control models. No covert monitoring/surveillance.

CAR / LOCATION
Support the owner’s authorized vehicle integration where available. If live manufacturer/vehicle data is unavailable, a free Bluetooth/GPS parked-location fallback may remember last parked location.
